approval_scope: existing10800s duration approval remains; this proposal changes numerical-failure handling only

proposed_numerical_failure_policy.dev_requirement: Every registered grid point must be attempted exactly once; all15/128 finite results required for an accuracy score. An observed NaN/Inf configuration is explicitly infeasible with accuracy=null, never zero or a prefix score. Untested points cannot be excluded.
proposed_numerical_failure_policy.numerical_error_match: Only the observed nonfinite geometry/latent numerical error from frozen guidance may be classified; source/asset/checkpoint/ID/RNG/probe-purity, OOM, transport, archive and unknown errors still stop for review.
proposed_numerical_failure_policy.selection: Use the unchanged primary all15 probability_mean and tie order among complete finite endpoints, after entire registered stage has accepted or explicitly numerical-infeasible status. Keep all failed rows and original selection exposure history.
proposed_numerical_failure_policy.confirmation: Freeze at most3unique feasible conditions and seeds0/1/2 before predictions. Failed seeds remain unavailable; never substitute seeds/conditions or report successful-seed confidence intervals as full confirmation.
proposed_numerical_failure_policy.continuation: Keep all existing bytes and failed slot untouched, execute only the10remaining rate points plus registered downstream stages within the existing cumulative budget; no extra points or repeated failures.

limitations: This is a post-failure exploratory protocol amendment, not the unchanged original preregistration.
The failure-specific continuation runner and its CPU safety/selection tests must be completed before any additional GPU launch.
